Classes, contracts and ownership

Choose the whole-project view or a subsystem. Click a class to inspect all declared attributes and operations, relationships, and its source location. Search includes nested and test classes.

Boxes show a compact selection of members; the inspector contains the full extracted list. Inherited members remain on their defining base class. React function components and type aliases are not classes. External libraries are boundary references.

UML notation
  • △ Solid line: inherits
  • △ Dashed line: implements / structural contract
  • ◆ Filled diamond at owner: composition
  • ◇ Hollow diamond: shared/injected aggregation
  • → Solid line: association
  • ⇢ Dashed line: dependency

Multiplicity labels describe targets per source instance: 0..1 optional, 1 required, * multiple. Inverse uniqueness is not asserted. Structural realization means signature-reviewed duck typing, not an explicit base declaration. Ownership notes in the inspector explain injection and process boundaries. + public; # Python underscore/protected convention; − private. Blank compartments mean no own members found, not an absence of inherited behavior.
